title: Storyboard
description: Output of the Storyboard Generator: a complete visual storyboard synthesizing the Camera/Motion/Lighting/Style Directors' decisions for every shot, for human approval (gate 1) before the Render Specification Generator compiles the final technical plan (gate 2, see render_plan.schema.json). See docs/adr/0008-storyboard-after-technical-planning.md for why this runs after per-shot planning rather than before it.

director_plan_version.description: Short content hash of the DirectorPlan this storyboard was generated from - changes automatically whenever the plan is revised.

visual_description.description: What happens in this shot, in plain language.

camera_framing.description: Human-readable rendering of Shot.camera.shot_type/angle - e.g. 'medium close-up, eye-level'.

lens_choice.description: Human-readable rendering of Shot.camera.focal_length_mm_equiv/depth_of_field - e.g. '50mm equivalent, shallow depth of field'.

camera_movement.description: Human-readable rendering of Shot.camera.movement - e.g. 'slow dolly-in, ease-in-out'.

lighting.description: Human-readable rendering of Shot.lighting - e.g. 'golden-hour key light from camera-left, soft fill, subtle volumetric haze'.

environment.description: Setting/location description, from the parent Scene.

mood.description: Short mood descriptor, from Shot.lighting.mood / the global style.

transition.description: Human-readable rendering of Shot.transition_in/transition_out - e.g. 'cut in, dissolve out'.

preview_image_asset_id.description: Optional low-cost generated preview image for this shot. Not populated until an image-generation engine is wired up (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's forward-compatibility notes for IImageEngine).
